mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, which signals robust economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0), the market anticipates a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 255.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150,000), the labor market supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0.
